request.prompt: Animate ONLY the single reference fighter, facing RIGHT, fixed side-view camera. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, identical costume, silhouette, palette and proportions. Solid flat #ff00ff background throughout, no floor, no shadows, no camera motion, no opponent, no text. Keep the entire actor, longest extensions and all props at least 15% away from EVERY camera edge through the whole motion; do not zoom in. Animate in place; the game engine supplies world movement. Action: get up — rise from low knockdown into ready stance. Interpret these six frame roles as six consecutive key moments of this video: frame 1 low grounded recovery, 2 plant support, 3 lift torso, 4 rising, 5 balance, 6 ready stance. CHARACTER BODY PASS ONLY: no explosions, muzzle flashes, impact bursts, detached projectiles or lingering trails. Those are separate runtime VFX/entities, not pixels baked into this body animation. Motion brief: Squat violet hermit-crab locksmith with a huge purple spiral shell, brass padlock details, pale eyes, oversized brass key claw, small purple claw, two sturdy boot legs. Side-view crisp 16-bit pixel art, always facing right. Move: get up — rise from low knockdown into ready stance. Side-view fighting game sprite row. Magenta background, full body visible, generous gutters, no cropping.
